CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to content is present; A is absent.

COD.rationale: Content (color-position) entries and separate origin/status entries are present for the same p0/current/n0 referent.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition linked to content organization is stated.

C.rationale: The report lists explicit content items (color-labelled position sets) for current nodes.

D.rationale: Content coordinates are listed separately from origin/status metadata, distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: Origins and inheritance labels describe how contents are organized/emerge for current and candidate states.
